description: Regional NP pathway viability data for nursing program locations

methodology.ed_opportunity: Level 1/2 trauma center density in metro area (0-1)
methodology.np_accessibility: Part-time/hybrid FNP/AGACNP programs for working nurses (0-1)
methodology.underserved_access: HPSA designations and FQHC density nearby (0-1)

Atlanta, GA.ed_notes: Multiple Level 1: Grady (busiest in Southeast), Wellstar Kennestone, Children's Healthcare of Atlanta
Atlanta, GA.np_notes: Emory, Kennesaw State, Mercer, Augusta - all offer part-time/hybrid FNP
Atlanta, GA.underserved_notes: Grady serves 1.8M residents, 40%+ uninsured; SW Atlanta HPSA; 10+ community health centers

Baltimore, MD.ed_notes: Johns Hopkins, R Adams Cowley Shock Trauma (national model); Level 2s include Bayview, Sinai
Baltimore, MD.np_notes: Notre Dame of Maryland (part-time FNP), UMSON hybrid, Johns Hopkins DNP
Baltimore, MD.underserved_notes: Baltimore City has most HPSA designations in region; Baltimore Medical System 8 health centers

Boston, MA.ed_notes: 5+ Level 1: MGH, Brigham, BIDMC, Boston Children's, Tufts
Boston, MA.np_notes: UMass Boston hybrid, MCPHS online, Northeastern hybrid, Regis online, Simmons
Boston, MA.underserved_notes: Multiple FQHCs in Roxbury, Dorchester; facility HPSAs designated

Charleston, SC.ed_notes: MUSC only Level 1 in Lowcountry (~2,100 trauma/year); Trident Level 2
Charleston, SC.np_notes: MUSC DNP-FNP hybrid; Charleston Southern MSN-FNP; USC Columbia online
Charleston, SC.underserved_notes: Fetter Health Care Network FQHC; moderate underserved population

Chicago, IL.ed_notes: 10+ Level 1: Northwestern, Stroger, UIC, Loyola, Mt. Sinai, Lutheran General
Chicago, IL.np_notes: Rush, UIC (AGACNP #8 nationally), Loyola, North Park - all part-time/hybrid
Chicago, IL.underserved_notes: 22 FQHCs with 150+ locations; 167 FQHCs in greater metro; large urban underserved

Cincinnati, OH.ed_notes: UC Medical Center only adult Level 1 in region; Cincinnati Children's Level 1 Pediatric
Cincinnati, OH.np_notes: UC hybrid FNP/AGACNP; Xavier part-time FNP; Ohio University online
Cincinnati, OH.underserved_notes: 67 FQHCs in Hamilton County; Cincinnati Health Dept serves 45K+ patients

Columbus, OH.ed_notes: OhioHealth Grant (busiest Level 1 in OH), OSU Wexner Level 1, Nationwide Children's Level 1 Pediatric
Columbus, OH.np_notes: OSU (#7 nationally), Mount Carmel online MSN, Ohio University online
Columbus, OH.underserved_notes: 33 FQHCs near Columbus; PrimaryOne Health 11 locations; OSU NP-led FQHC

Dallas, TX.ed_notes: 4+ Level 1: Parkland, Baylor, Texas Health Dallas, UT Southwestern
Dallas, TX.np_notes: TWU hybrid FNP, UT Arlington online, UTMB dual FNP-AGACNP
Dallas, TX.underserved_notes: Only 4 FQHCs with ~29 sites - significantly fewer than Houston

Denver, CO.ed_notes: Denver Health Level 1 (Ernest E. Moore Shock Trauma); UCHealth Level 1; Children's Hospital Level 1 Pediatric
Denver, CO.np_notes: CU Anschutz (first NP programs in US) online+intensives; UNC meets 1 day/week; full practice authority since 2010
Denver, CO.underserved_notes: 56 FQHCs in Denver; STRIDE CHC 13 clinics; Denver Health serves 177K

Durham, NC.ed_notes: Duke Level 1; UNC Chapel Hill Level 1 (10 miles away)
Durham, NC.np_notes: Duke distance-learning MSN-FNP/AGACNP (3 campus visits); UNC hybrid
Durham, NC.underserved_notes: Population-based HPSAs; NC has significant rural shortages statewide

Fullerton, CA.ed_notes: Orange County has 1 Level 1 (UCI); 2-3 Level 2; no trauma center in Fullerton itself
Fullerton, CA.np_notes: CSUF limited NP; Cal State Dominguez Hills online FNP; may need LA-area programs
Fullerton, CA.underserved_notes: Orange County more affluent; fewer HPSA designations than LA County

Houston, TX.ed_notes: Texas Medical Center - largest in world; Memorial Hermann-TMC busiest in US (40K trauma/yr); Ben Taub Level 1
Houston, TX.np_notes: UTHealth Cizik (#1 DNP in TX) hybrid; TWU Houston; affordable tuition
Houston, TX.underserved_notes: ~120 FQHC sites in Harris County (4x Dallas); large underserved population

Knoxville, TN.ed_notes: UT Medical Center only Level 1 in East Tennessee, serving 21 counties
Knoxville, TN.np_notes: UTK BSN-DNP FNP hybrid; UTC, Tennessee Tech online; Carson-Newman
Knoxville, TN.underserved_notes: Gateway to Appalachian TN; 92/95 TN counties HPSA; 10 distressed Appalachian counties nearby

Lexington, KY.ed_notes: UK Chandler only Level 1 in central/eastern KY; only 4 Level 1 statewide
Lexington, KY.np_notes: UK hybrid BSN-DNP; Frontier Nursing (first FNP program in US); NKU online
Lexington, KY.underserved_notes: 107/120 KY counties HPSA; 54 Appalachian counties; Perry County life expectancy 67 vs national 78.5

Los Angeles, CA.ed_notes: 2 Level 1 (LA General, CHLA pediatric); 10+ Level 2 including Harbor-UCLA, Cedars-Sinai
Los Angeles, CA.np_notes: Cal State LA FNP/AGACNP; UCLA new BSN-DNP AGACNP (Fall 2025); USC online FNP
Los Angeles, CA.underserved_notes: Highest FQHC density in state: 47 orgs, 232 sites; AltaMed serves 240K annually

Madison, WI.ed_notes: UW Health only Level 1 in Madison, one of only two in Wisconsin
Madison, WI.np_notes: UW-Madison DNP #1 in WI; AGACNP evenings/weekends; Herzing online FNP
Madison, WI.underserved_notes: 4 FQHCs near Madison; lower urban underserved density

Milwaukee, WI.ed_notes: Froedtert only adult Level 1 in eastern WI; one of only two Level 1 in state
Milwaukee, WI.np_notes: Marquette hybrid FNP, UW-Milwaukee DNP, Alverno, Concordia affordable MSN
Milwaukee, WI.underserved_notes: Milwaukee County HPSAs; significant health disparities in inner-city

Nashville, TN.ed_notes: Two Level 1: Vanderbilt (adult/pediatric), TriStar Skyline; multiple Level 2/3
Nashville, TN.np_notes: Vanderbilt #2 FNP, #1 AGACNP nationally; hybrid with block intensives; Belmont, Tennessee State
Nashville, TN.underserved_notes: Nashville General serves underserved; 92/95 TN counties HPSA; 190 FQHC sites statewide

New Haven, CT.ed_notes: Yale-New Haven 1 of only 2 adult Level 1 in CT; also Level 1 Pediatric
New Haven, CT.np_notes: Yale BSN-to-FNP/AGNP; Southern CT State FNP; CT grants full practice authority
New Haven, CT.underserved_notes: Fair Haven CHC serves 36K+ at 21 locations; 2024 HRSA funding (top 20% nationwide)

New York, NY.ed_notes: 9+ Level 1: NYP, NYU Langone, Lincoln (busiest ED in NYC), Bellevue; highest volume in region
New York, NY.np_notes: Pace hybrid, Columbia DNP-AGACNP, NYU, Long Island University; NY allows full practice authority
New York, NY.underserved_notes: Extensive FQHC network: NYC H+H/Gotham Health 30 sites; many HPSAs in Bronx, Brooklyn, Harlem

Northridge, CA.ed_notes: Northridge Hospital Level 2 - only pediatric trauma in San Fernando Valley; Providence Holy Cross Level 2 nearby
Northridge, CA.np_notes: CSUN has no FNP/AGACNP; would need Cal State LA, UCLA, or online programs
Northridge, CA.underserved_notes: San Fernando Valley mixed demographics; access to LA County FQHC network

Oakland, CA.ed_notes: Highland Hospital 1 of only 4 adult Level 1 in Bay Area; UCSF Benioff Children's Level 1 Pediatric
Oakland, CA.np_notes: Samuel Merritt BSN-to-FNP online; UCSF 8 NP tracks; SF State evening FNP
Oakland, CA.underserved_notes: CHCN serves 285K at 135+ sites; Lifelong Medical Care; Benioff 70%+ government-insured

Omaha, NE.ed_notes: Nebraska Medicine only ACS-verified Level 1 for adult+pediatric in state; CHI Creighton-Bergan Mercy Level 1
Omaha, NE.np_notes: Creighton University highly regarded; Clarkson College hybrid
Omaha, NE.underserved_notes: 28 FQHCs in Omaha; OneWorld, Charles Drew serve underserved; 123K+ patients statewide

Philadelphia, PA.ed_notes: 5+ Level 1: Temple (busiest penetrating trauma in PA), Penn Presbyterian, Einstein, Jefferson
Philadelphia, PA.np_notes: UPenn (top-ranked) hybrid, Drexel mostly online, Widener hybrid, Saint Joseph's online
Philadelphia, PA.underserved_notes: North Philadelphia MUA; Esperanza 3 sites; 15+ FQHC orgs via Health Federation

Phoenix, AZ.ed_notes: 4 Level 1: St. Joseph's, Banner-UMC, HonorHealth Deer Valley, HonorHealth John C. Lincoln; Phoenix Children's
Phoenix, AZ.np_notes: GCU hybrid FNP/AGACNP; U of Arizona hybrid AGACNP; ASU part-time DNP
Phoenix, AZ.underserved_notes: 41 FQHCs in Phoenix; $24.3M county investment 2025; Valleywise Health 11 sites

Pittsburgh, PA.ed_notes: 3 Level 1: UPMC Presbyterian, UPMC Mercy (only combined trauma+burn in western PA), Allegheny General
Pittsburgh, PA.np_notes: Duquesne mostly online (100% pass rates), Pitt distance DNP, Carlow hybrid evening
Pittsburgh, PA.underserved_notes: 22 FQHCs in Allegheny County; Primary Care Health Services 9 sites; some population HPSAs

Rochester, NY.ed_notes: Strong Memorial only Level 1 in Monroe County/Finger Lakes; includes Golisano Children's Level 1 Pediatric
Rochester, NY.np_notes: U of Rochester hybrid part-time; St. John Fisher evening; Roberts Wesleyan hybrid
Rochester, NY.underserved_notes: Limited FQHC density; some urban population HPSAs; Anthony Jordan Health Center

Seattle, WA.ed_notes: Harborview ONLY Level 1 in entire Washington state; Level 2s include MultiCare Tacoma, St. Joseph
Seattle, WA.np_notes: Seattle University part-time BSN-DNP; UW hybrid DNP; Gonzaga online; WA grants full practice authority
Seattle, WA.underserved_notes: King County FQHCs: Neighborcare 30+ sites, HealthPoint 17 locations; rural eastern WA shortages

St. Paul, MN.ed_notes: Regions Hospital Level 1 (only in east metro); Twin Cities has 3 adult Level 1 total; Children's MN Level 1 Pediatric
St. Paul, MN.np_notes: U of Minnesota hybrid AGACNP; Metro State online DNP-FNP; full practice authority since 2015
St. Paul, MN.underserved_notes: Open Cities, Minnesota Community Care FQHCs; 17 CHCs statewide with 80+ sites

Sylvania, OH (Toledo area).ed_notes: ProMedica Toledo Hospital Level 1 (largest in NW Ohio/SE Michigan); Mercy St. Vincent Level 1
Sylvania, OH (Toledo area).np_notes: University of Toledo FNP online, AGACNP hybrid; 20% lower tuition than Cleveland/Columbus
Sylvania, OH (Toledo area).underserved_notes: Neighborhood Health Association 50+ years serving Toledo; multiple FQHCs; Lucas County HPSAs
